visualReview.method: Independent model review of real normal gameplay JPEGs and labelled native/3x decoded phase crops; not human playback, physical testing or FPS proof.
visualReview.finding: Backward-step calves retain rounded orange mass and move as articulated pieces instead of the former exposed thin diagonal ribbons. Both directions and Square/street agree; boots remain distinct and passing overlap is natural.
visualReview.attachment: Original baby/pouch/head/neck remains continuous in sampled main and native back-carrier frames. No sampled third limb, open hem or detached boot.
visualReview.limits: Some shorts-panel corners and stripe angles remain rigid at3x; this is still a painted articulated rig rather than newly drawn smooth cloth. Screen-aligned image width is not the quantitative volume metric.
